quarterly_data.signal: On July 14, 2026 Vistra received its PJM Capacity Auction results for planning year 2028/2029: it cleared approximately 10,924 MW at a weighted average clearing price of $325.00 per megawatt-day. Every zone cleared at $325.00, including RTO 4,129.90 MW, ATSI 2,069.50 MW, EMAAC 1,819.00 MW, COMED 1,174.00 MW and DOM 219.70 MW.
